clips.title: The story
paras: Abercrombie in western Duskwood asks travelers to fetch a rare thread from Darkshire. The hermit claims he is too frail to cross the haunted woods and asks for Ghost Hair Thread from Madame Eva.

North of Raven Hill Cemetery, Abercrombie lives alone in a shack in western Duskwood. He tells travelers that age and frailty keep him from making the dangerous journey through the woods to buy goods in Darkshire. His request seems simple: go to the township's town square and speak with Madame Eva for a spool of Ghost Hair Thread.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.
Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread? You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
